# Mett Global

> Mett Global is a digital marketing agency, custom software development consultancy, and ecommerce supply chain operations firm founded in 2025. Headquartered in Islamabad, Pakistan with U.S. business representation, Mett Global actively serves clients in the USA and Pakistan, as well as worldwide.

Serving clients in the USA and Pakistan.

## Verified Leadership
- **Hammad Ayub**: Founder
- **Muhammad Ahmad Aamir**: Co-Founder & COO
- **Usman Rafiq**: Director, U.S. Business Development

## Core Service Pillars (in operational order)

### 1. Paid Media and Social Media (Digital Marketing & Growth)
- **Performance Marketing**: Targeted Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns engineered for measurable return on ad spend, qualified lead generation, and customer acquisition.
- **Automotive and Dealership Marketing**: Full-funnel digital marketing, billboard visibility, CRM lead automation, and showroom footfall generation. Verified results include Jetour Ittehad (1,000+ verified leads and 50+ confirmed bookings) and CSM Ittehad EV launch (about 400 leads and 112 confirmed showroom visits).
- **Search Engine Optimization**: High-authority technical SEO, Local Map Pack optimization, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

### 2. Ecommerce and Marketplace Operations (Amazon and Walmart Claims)
- **Marketplace Claims Recovery**: Manual forensic audits for Amazon FBA and Walmart WFS lost, damaged, and customer return discrepancies. Over £50,000 recovered in one year for a leading global brand.
- **Multichannel Marketplace Operations**: Catalog management, inventory planning, and daily operations across Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, Shopify, and eBay.
- **Remote Warehouse and 3PL Coordination**: Coordinating inbound shipments, pallet prep, and freight invoice reconciliation.

### 3. Web and Software Development
- **Custom Dealership ERP and CRM Software**: Tailored platforms connecting vehicle inventory, speed-to-lead routing, and showroom workflows (currently in active development).
- **High-Performance Web Platforms**: Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS architectures engineered for sub-second load times and high Core Web Vitals.
- **Mobile and Portal Engineering**: Cross-platform Flutter mobile applications and secure B2B client partner portals.

### 4. AI Automation
- **Workflow Automation**: Eliminating manual data entry between forms, spreadsheets, CRMs, and accounting ledgers.
- **Speed-to-Lead and Customer Inquiries**: Instant WhatsApp/SMS notifications, automated lead routing, and customer support triage assistants with human-in-the-loop review.

- [Amazon Claims Recovery](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/claims-recovery): Over £50,000 recovered in one year for a leading global brand across courier and marketplace reimbursement claims.

- [Remote US Warehouse Management](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/remote-warehouse-management): Warehouse coordination and inventory accuracy.
- [Jetour Dealership Marketing Islamabad](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/jetour-ittehad): 1,000+ verified leads and 50+ confirmed vehicle bookings.

- [Hyundai Islamabad Connected Showroom](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/hyundai-islamabad): Connected local growth funnel.
- [Dealership ERP Platform](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/dealership-erp): Multi-showroom operational architecture.
- [Serenada Mental Health (Texas, USA)](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/serenada-mental-health): Healthcare website design and local medical SEO.
- [Prospect Smile Dental (Illinois, USA)](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/prospect-smile): Dental practice website and local SEO in Mount Prospect.
- [Luxury O'Hare Limo (Chicago, USA)](https://www.mettglobal.com/portfolio/luxury-ohare-limo): Chauffeured transportation website and SEO.

## Authoritative Field Guides and Operator Articles
- [Walmart WFS Reimbursement: File a Lost Inventory Claim](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-walmart-wfs-reimbursement-claim): How to file a Walmart WFS reimbursement claim for lost inbound inventory within the 10 to 50 day window in Seller Center.
- [WFS Returns Not Received? Walmart Return Dispute Guide](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-walmart-wfs-returns-reimbursement): Dispute windows, proof requirements, and non-reimbursable return exceptions for Walmart WFS returns.
- [Meta Lead Ads Higher Intent: Fix Low Quality Leads](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-meta-lead-ads-lead-quality): How Higher Intent forms, qualifying questions, fast response, and Conversions API integration stop low-quality lead generation.
- [Meta Ads Agency for Ecommerce Brands: What to Expect](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-meta-ads-agency-ecommerce): What direct-to-consumer and marketplace brands should expect from a dedicated Meta ads partner.
- [Amazon FBA Reimbursement Service: How Claims Recovery Works](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-amazon-fba-reimbursement-service): How manual claims recovery audits lost, damaged, and customer return discrepancies under current Amazon windows.
- [Outsourced Ecommerce Operations for US Amazon and Walmart Sellers](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-outsourced-ecommerce-operations): Streamlining multichannel catalog health, inbound replenishment, and warehouse coordination.
- [Custom Dealership ERP vs Off the Shelf Software](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-dealership-erp-software): Why multi-showroom automotive dealerships choose custom ERP platforms over rigid SaaS software.
- [AI Automation Agency for Small Businesses: Where to Start](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-ai-automation-agency-small-business): Practical AI automation starting points for speed-to-lead routing, document extraction, and support triage.
- [Digital Marketing Agency in Islamabad: How We Grow Car Dealerships](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-digital-marketing-agency-islamabad): How automotive dealerships in Islamabad convert digital attention into confirmed showroom footfall.
- [Custom Software Development Company in Pakistan: ERP and Web Apps](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-software-development-company-pakistan): Scalable Next.js web applications, dealership ERPs, and client portals built by engineering teams in Pakistan.
- [Amazon FBA Lost and Damaged Inventory Guide](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-amazon-fba-lost-damaged-inventory): Reading FBA Inventory Ledger codes and filing claims inside Amazon current windows for each case type.
- [Manual vs Automated Amazon Reimbursements Guide](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-manual-amazon-reimbursement-vs-bots): Where reimbursement software helps, where claims still need a person, and what Amazon policy says about claim volume.
- [Amazon FBA Inbound Shipment Loss Guide](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-amazon-fba-inbound-claims): Auditing receiving dock shortages and carrier discrepancies.
- [Amazon FBA Weight & Dimension Fee Audit Guide](https://www.mettglobal.com/insight-amazon-fba-fee-audit): Auditing automated Cubiscan laser scanner errors and fee disputes.
